events.evidence: Moody's downgrades the ratings of France's three biggest banks
Stock prices rise at stock exchanges around the world, and some analysts see this as a reaction to a fiscal agreement among the leaders of the eurozone
David Cameron, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, refuses to join a European Union financial crisis accord after negotiations in Brussels

label.note: French bank downgrades and UK veto offset by global stock rally after eurozone fiscal agreement.
